title: Product hero: still to slow orbit
style: Premium product photography, matte black seamless backdrop, one soft key light from the upper left, thin rim light, crisp reflections, no text, no logos.

keyframes.prompt: A brushed-steel wireless earbud case, lid half open, standing on a low black acrylic plinth, centered with empty space on both sides. 16:9 composition.

shots.video_prompt: The camera orbits slowly a quarter turn to the right around the earbud case, keeping it centered. The lid opens the rest of the way at the halfway point and a soft blue status light comes on. Reflections slide across the steel. Quiet ambient hum, one soft click when the lid stops.
